scope: Current Ethereum Concentrator aCRV (AladdinCRVV2) fixed cvxCRV compounder. Five direct cvxCRV/CRV/fixed-wrapper deposit and cvxCRV withdrawal/redemption functions; distinct product/address from f(x) fxSAVE, despite common Aladdin ecosystem.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Official current contracts table lists AladdinCRV/aCRV at the reviewed address without deprecation, while separately marking AladdinConvexVault 0xc8fF...E0e8 deprecated. Official product docs and tutorial continue to describe direct CRV/cvxCRV to aCRV deposits and unwrapping. Current app still exposes aCRV category and cvxcrv harvester entry, but its static compounder section does not itself establish a live aCRV AUM quote. Explorer snapshot shows depositWithCRV on 2026-10-19 and current deposit on 2026-10-16, plus withdrawals; reviewed sources contain no target retirement/wind-down/disband notice. Lifecycle inference is bounded to these signals, not DAU, transaction success, fresh runtime availability or vault TVL. Source annotations deprecate legacy overloads, not the entire upgraded aCRV product.

abiEvidence.evidence: Complete actual deployed implementation ABI and source from Sourcify v2, bound by its reported EIP1967Proxy resolution; no generic ERC4626 substitution or fresh RPC attestation.

sourceSemantics.binding: Sourcify reports EIP1967Proxy 0x2b95...0884 implementation AladdinCRVV2 0x9A68...d3d3; explorer proxy page reports the same. Applicable implementation is Exact Match on Etherscan and exact_match for Sourcify creation/runtime. Proxy itself is Similar Match on Etherscan (reference 0xe293Bf6BcF1A72768dA0209F437491046359b9f2), and Sourcify reports match/match rather than exact_match; these labels are intentionally not conflated. Constructor binds CRV/cvxCRV Curve pool 0x971add32ea87f10bd192671630be3be8a11b8623 and wrapper 0xaa0c3f5f7dfd688c6e646f66cd2a6b66acdbe434.
sourceSemantics.ordinaryFlow: Current deposit(uint256,address) transfers fixed cvxCRV to configured strategy, calls strategy.deposit and mints aCRV. CRV input path chooses constructor-bound Curve exchange or fixed Convex CRV depositor; no arbitrary target/route data. Fixed wrapper input sends only wrapper shares to strategy. Current withdraw/redeem burn authorized owner shares and receive strategy cvxCRV; owner-specific fee applies and final holder harvests before exit.
sourceSemantics.unusableMint: mint(uint256,address) is marked nonReentrant and directly internally calls public deposit(uint256,address), also nonReentrant; inherited ReentrancyGuard status is ENTERED during the inner call and always reverts. Excluded even though ABI resembles ERC4626. No runtime simulation claimed.
sourceSemantics.excludedLegacy: deposit(address,uint256), depositAll, depositAllWithCRV, enum-option withdraw and withdrawAll are source-deprecated and not selected. balanceOfUnderlying is source-deprecated view only. No legacy AladdinConvexVault admission.

limitations: Static deployment/ABI admission only; no fresh RPC bytecode, storage, simulation, liquidity or successful-execution guarantee. Independent authorization, canonical calldata, pause and signing controls remain mandatory.

Withdraw/redeem charges the owner-specific withdrawal fee (except the final holder, whose exit harvests). Preview functions use the default fee and may not match customized owner fees; max* views return uint256 max rather than user-specific executable limits.
